text:
Mia: FYI PR #4899 adds an Optimize Toolkit migration paragraph but some examples are stale and a couple links break. tagging @Sanjay for fixes.
Sanjay: looking. which links? can you paste the failures?
docs-bot: automated linkcheck: 2 broken links in docs/optkit/migrate.md -> optkit/snippets/old-prefetch.md and examples/go/prefetch_old.go
Leo: also spotted an API casing mismatch in the Go example: uses PrefetchEnabled instead of prefetch_enabled like rest of SDK. that'll confuse users.
Mia: and the Python sample recommends batch_size=64 for short sequences; we should recommend 8-16 and mention memory/latency tradeoffs.
Sanjay: I'll open a branch to: 1) replace broken links, 2) update Go/Python snippets to current API, 3) add quantization guidance, 4) small KV vs prefix cache note. ETA later today.
Anya: I can run a smoke pass on the updated snippets. which sample file to use?
Leo: use examples/demo-prompts/shortseq-sampled-5k.txt and run: `./bin/optkit-run --file examples/demo-prompts/shortseq-sampled-5k.txt --batch 12 --prefetch true`
Anya: running now. will report back with throughput/latency.
Sanjay: patch pushed to `docs-fix/optkit-mig` with updated snippets + clarifying paragraph on when to use prefetch vs prefix cache. PTAL.
Mia: can someone add a one-line migration checklist to the PR desc so engineers can run through quick steps?
Leo: suggested checklist in PR: - update SDK snippet names and casing - validate batch_size on your shortseq vs longseq workload - pick quant profile (q4_0 for latency; q2_k_m for memory) and run smoke eval - attach perf logs - update any internal links to /optkit/examples/*
Anya: smoke results: no exceptions. sample output below:
```
[run] batch=12 prefetch=true
Request 0: tokens=48 latency=35ms
Request 1: tokens=96 latency=88ms
Aggregate: ~165 req/s, p95=220ms
```
Anya: uploading artifact: smoke-shortseq-b12-2026-03-23.log to PR.
Sanjay: added migration checklist to PR description and linked smoke artifact. also fixed the two broken links and normalized SDK naming to snake_case.
ci-bot: CI started for branch docs-fix/optkit-mig 3: queued
Mia: thanks. one last ask: add a short blurb for quant profile validation (run your evaluation prompts and check n-gram entropy/regression). keep it brief.
Sanjay: added a 3-line note about validating quant profiles against eval sets and a small recommended sanity check command.
Mia: assigning: @Sanjay (merge once CI green), @Anya (confirm logs remain attached), @Leo (final copy edit). I'll merge tomorrow AM if everything is green. :thumbsup:
